text: Seabrook Town’s aggressive pressing paid off as Tariq Marlowe won a high turnover deep in their own half, launching a swift counter-attack that caught Harbour City off guard [#696] [#697]. However, Marlowe's off-target shot from close range (7.4 meters) highlighted the need for better finishing under pressure and possibly more support in final-third moves, as the chance arose from individual effort rather than the team's usual wide crossing strategy [#698]. Harbour City’s patient short passing was disrupted, but Seabrook Town must improve the quality of their quick transitions to fully capitalize on such turnovers. Emphasize in training the importance of composure and support in rapid break scenarios to convert these high-value chances more effectively.
